record.question: The International Conference on Climate Change was recently held at
record.explanation: Answer D: Copenhagen. UNFCCC’s original COP 15 document register identifies the conference in Copenhagen, Denmark, 7–18 December 2009, immediately before the March 2010 exam. Reference: https://www.unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/conferences/past-conferences/copenhagen-climate-change-conference-december-2009/cop-15/cop-15-documents. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
